Oneliner

Technology demonstration and Earth observation.
Description

Efir is a technology demonstration and Earth observation mission. Its primary purpose is to disseminate hands-on experience in satellite system/subsystem-level design to Bulgarian universities. Efir's secondary objective is to track vegetation health in Bulgaria and threatened ecosystems across the planet.
